engine.status: SHADOW PILOT (VIG-PGA-001B, proposed). Not production scoring and not Annex A, whose original method has not been recovered.
rules: Opportunity (O) and Resistance (R) are two independent 0–6 scores. They are not added, subtracted or treated as probabilities.
Each category is 1, 0 or UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN never counts as 0.
A score stays INCOMPLETE until all six categories are assessed.
High O with high R stays visible as "high upside, high risk", never collapsed into "avoid".
Scores are decision support, not vetoes.
